info.name: NestJS Base API
info.description: Generated from the running OpenAPI document. Import the matching Postman environment, then run Auth first. Sample IDs are captured from create responses. Admin, file-upload, email-token, 2FA, and external-provider requests are skipped unless their prerequisites are configured.

item.name: Issue a CSRF token for cookie-authenticated clients

exec: const data = json && json.data ? json.data : json;

const accessToken = data && data.access_token; if (accessToken) { try { const payload = JSON.parse(atob(accessToken.split(".")[1].replace(/-/g, "+").replace(/_/g, "/"))); const userId = payload.user_id || payload.sub; if (userId) { pm.collectionVariables.set("user_id", userId); pm.environment.set("user_id", userId); } } catch {} }

if (accessToken && pm.environment.get("admin_email") && pm.environment.get("demo_email") === pm.environment.get("admin_email")) { pm.collectionVariables.set("admin_access_token", accessToken); pm.environment.set("admin_access_token", accessToken); }

item.name: User sign up to platform

exec: const adminEmail = pm.environment.get("admin_email") || ""; const currentEmail = pm.environment.get("demo_email") || pm.collectionVariables.get("demo_email") || ""; if (adminEmail && currentEmail === adminEmail) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); } else if (!currentEmail || currentEmail.startsWith("postman-")) { const email = `postman-${Date.now()}-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000)}@example.test`; pm.collectionVariables.set("demo_email", email); pm.environment.set("demo_email", email); }
